snapshots.name: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
snapshots.subtitle: A wealthy, disreputable landowner
snapshots.body: Vulgar, calculating, and given to buffoonery, he has fathered three sons by two wives and largely neglected all of them. His quarrel with his eldest son over money and a woman sets the whole family drama in motion.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Mitya
snapshots.subtitle: Fyodor's eldest son, an army officer
snapshots.body: Passionate, reckless with money, and locked in a bitter dispute with his father over his inheritance, he is also his father's rival for the same woman. His volatile temper makes him the family's most visibly dangerous member.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Ivan Fyodorovitch
snapshots.subtitle: Fyodor's middle son, an intellectual
snapshots.body: Educated, brooding, and skeptical of the faith his youngest brother has embraced, he has returned to his father's town for reasons he does not fully explain. His private arguments about God and suffering trouble everyone who hears them.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Alexey Fyodorovitch Karamazov
snapshots.subtitle: Fyodor's youngest son, a novice at the monastery
snapshots.body: Gentle and devout, he has attached himself to the monastery under the guidance of the elder Zossima rather than to his own chaotic family. He is nonetheless the one relative both his father and his brothers trust enough to confide in.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Smerdyakov
snapshots.subtitle: Fyodor's cook and servant, rumored to be his illegitimate son
snapshots.body: Sullen, epileptic, and unusually well-read for his station, he keeps his own counsel about the household he serves. His quiet presence in Fyodor's house draws less notice than it probably deserves.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Grushenka
snapshots.subtitle: A local beauty both Fyodor and Dmitri are pursuing
snapshots.body: Independent and shrewd about the men who compete for her attention, she keeps both father and son on unequal footing, without committing to either. Her own past holds an old attachment neither Karamazov knows about yet.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Katerina Ivanovna
snapshots.subtitle: Dmitri's proud fiancée
snapshots.body: Well-born and fiercely devoted out of a sense of honor rather than uncomplicated love, she once accepted help from Dmitri at a low point in her family's fortunes and has felt bound to him ever since. Her feelings toward him are far more tangled than her public loyalty suggests.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Father Zossima
snapshots.subtitle: A revered elder at the monastery
snapshots.body: Wise and gentle, he is Alyosha's spiritual guide and a figure of real authority among the monks and the townspeople who seek him out. His health is failing as the story opens.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Rakitin
snapshots.subtitle: A seminary student, Alyosha's acquaintance
snapshots.body: Ambitious and cynical beneath a show of progressive ideas, he watches the Karamazov family's troubles with an eye to what he might gain from them. His friendship with Alyosha is considerably more self-interested than it looks.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Madame Hohlakov
snapshots.subtitle: A wealthy, excitable widow in the town
snapshots.body: Given to sudden enthusiasms and constant talk, she is a regular visitor to the monastery and a close, if exhausting, friend to Katerina Ivanovna. Her household includes her invalid daughter Lise.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Lise
snapshots.subtitle: Madame Hohlakov's young, invalid daughter
snapshots.body: Confined to a wheelchair and given to strange, provoking moods, she has formed an odd attachment to Alyosha that neither of them quite knows what to do with. Her sharp tongue often startles people who expect only sweetness from an invalid.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Grigory
snapshots.subtitle: An old, devoted servant in Fyodor's household
snapshots.body: Rigid, pious, and the closest thing to a real parent Smerdyakov ever had, he has served the Karamazov household for decades. His loyalty to Fyodor does not extend to approving of anything the old man actually does.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Captain Snegiryov
snapshots.subtitle: A poor, humiliated former army captain
snapshots.body: Reduced to poverty and once publicly disgraced by Dmitri in front of his own son, he lives with his sickly family in near-destitution. His son Ilusha's schoolyard troubles connect him unexpectedly to Alyosha.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Ilusha
snapshots.subtitle: Captain Snegiryov's young son
snapshots.body: A proud, unhappy schoolboy who was mocked and mistreated by his classmates after Dmitri's public insult to his father. Alyosha takes a particular interest in the boy and the crowd of schoolmates around him.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Krassotkin
snapshots.subtitle: A clever, self-important schoolboy
snapshots.body: Precocious and eager to seem more grown-up than his years, he leads the group of boys connected to Ilusha and eventually strikes up an odd rapport with Alyosha. His confidence is only rarely dented.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.
